title: 4 custom agent / Where to find them
content:
## Where to find them

![Screenshot of the chat icon and gear icon in the VS Code title bar](../images/customizations/chat-icon-gear.png)
Custom agents are easily located in the Agent Customizations view under the Agents section which you can get to by opening chat and selecting its gear.

![Screenshot of the Agent Customizations view showing the Agents section with built-in and custom agents](../images/customizations/ep-4-1-cust-agents.png)

From here, you can view built-in agents as well as any custom agents you’ve created. Each one represents a specialized role that you can activate when needed.
